baseline.note: First 36 journeys; the 54 contrasts were added after the first fixes. Two phrasings created an order at awaiting_final_confirm without 'confirmar'.

criticalFinding: At awaiting_final_confirm, tryConfirmOrder creates the order. Several edit routes (inline note, standalone exclusion 'sin X', contact phone) called it to refresh the summary, so 'sin cebolla porfa', 'sin hielo' or a new phone number created the order without explicit approval (agent on and off).
fixes: General guard: an order signature (consolidated cart, fulfilment, destination, payment, contact phone) is taken at turn start; if it differs when tryConfirmOrder would create the order, the summary is shown again instead (Mercado Pago skipFinalConfirm exempt)
Inline note route at final confirm re-enters through 'confirming'
Note revision parser/handler: retire a stored clause, clear notes, or reverse 'sin X' to 'con X' on the selected row or a subset of its units; requires the contradicted clause to exist
Ambiguous note revision stored as pendingCartNoteEdit (cart signature, candidates); joins CART_EDIT_SELECTION_KEYS so confirm, withdrawal and stale-list handling apply
Counted option edit accepts a second configured attribute in the same request and applies both atomically, directly or after line clarification
Option removed from catalog during clarification is named in the reply; cart unchanged
concurrency: Another agent (Codex) began the same batch in this checkout and left an uncompiled handler importing a missing module. After 10 idle minutes and user instruction, its handler was kept and completed rather than replaced.

firstGlobal.cause: New Map accessed without optional chaining in specs that build the service via prototype; fixed, then full global repeated

fixtures: Synthetic menus: bao/salsa, pizza/masa, batido/base, each with Tamaño Normal/Grande; seeded two-line carts at awaiting_final_confirm
mocks: Agent mock on/off, ordersService.create stub; no maps/model/Meta calls
limitations: Seeded carts, not purchases from scratch
Mock agent does not credit real model understanding
Only phrasings in the spec are credited; other note-reversal wordings fall back to previous routes
Other tryConfirmOrder callers are covered by the general guard only within the same inbound turn
